\displaystyle+2K^{2}\mu_{U}^{2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right]. $$

We can further bound the term in Equation (S28) as,

$$ \displaystyle~\frac{2}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{j\leq k_{1}<k_{2}\leq T}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k_{1}}R_{k_{2}}\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{1}}=a_{1})\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{2}}=a_{2})}{\hat{\pi}_{k_{1}-1}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a_{1})\hat{\pi}_{k_{2}-1}(\bm{X}_{k_{2}},a_{2})}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a)\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{2}},a)\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{2}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{j\leq k_{1}<k_{2}\leq T}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k_{1}}\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{1}}=a_{1})}{\hat{\pi}_{k_{1}-1}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a_{1})}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a)\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{2}},a)\frac{R_{k_{2}}\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{2}}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k_{2}-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\Bigr|\bm{H}_{k_{2}-1}\right]\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{2}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{j\leq k_{1}<k_{2}\leq T}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k_{1}}\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{1}}=a_{1})}{\hat{\pi}_{k_{1}-1}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a_{1})}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a)\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\right]\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{2}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{j\leq k_{1}<k_{2}\leq T}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k_{1}}\mathbb{I}(A_{k_{1}}=a_{1})}{\hat{\pi}_{k_{1}-1}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a_{1})}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k_{1}},a)\Bigr|\bm{H}_{k_{1}-1}\right]\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\right]\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{2}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{j\leq k_{1}<k_{2}\leq T}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\right]^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~\frac{2K^{2}\mu_{U}^{2}(T-j)}{T-j+1}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~2K^{2}\mu_{U}^{2}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] $$

Lastly, we bound the term in Equation (S29) as,

$$ \displaystyle~\frac{1}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{a_{1}=1}^{K}\sum_{a_{2}=1}^{K}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}^{2}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a_{1})\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a_{2})}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)^{2}}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)^{2}\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{1}{(T-j+1)^{2}}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}^{2}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)^{2}}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~\frac{(\mu_{U}^{2}+\sigma_{U}^{2})(T-1)^{\eta}K}{T-j+1}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle~\mathbb{E}\left[\left\{\frac{1}{T-j+1}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)+\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{k-1}\right]\right)\right\}^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~2K^{2}(\mu_{U}^{2}+\sigma_{U}^{2})(T-1)^{\eta}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] $$

Plugging Equations (S27) and (S31) into Equation (S26), we have

$$ \displaystyle(T-1)\sum_{j=2}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\{\frac{1}{T-j+1}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{k-1}\right]\right)\right\}^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \displaystyle~\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[\left\{\frac{1}{T-j+1}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)+\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{k-1}\right]\right)\right\}^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~(T-1)\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sqrt{\frac{4K(\mu_{U}^{2}+\sigma_{U}^{2})(T-1)^{\eta}}{T-j+1}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right]}\cdot\sqrt{2K^{2}(\mu_{U}^{2}+\sigma_{U}^{2})(T-1)^{\eta}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right]} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle~2\sqrt{2}(\mu_{U}^{2}+\sigma_{U}^{2})K^{\frac{3}{2}}(T-1)^{1+\eta}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\frac{1}{\sqrt{T-j+1}}\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right]. $$

Notice for any $a$ , $T$ , $j$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1(\bm{X},a)}}{T-1}\right)^{2}\right]+2\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1(\bm{X},a)}}{T-1}\right)\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}{T-1}\right]+\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}\right]. $$

By Lemma 6,

$$ \sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(X_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(X_{j},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2}\right]=o\left(\frac{1}{(T-1)^{1+\eta}}\right). $$

In addition, by Lemma 5, we have,

$$ \sum_{j=2}^{T}2\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}{T-1}\right)\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}{T-1}\right]=O\left(\frac{\log T}{(T-1)^{1+\min(\delta,1)}}\right). $$

Furthermore,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=2}^{T}\frac{1}{\sqrt{T-j+1}}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}\right]\leq \displaystyle\frac{K}{(T-1)^{2}}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\frac{1}{\sqrt{T-j+1}}=O\left(\frac{1}{(T-1)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right). $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=2}^{T}\frac{1}{\sqrt{T-j+1}}\mathbb{E}\left[\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X},a)^{2}\right] \displaystyle=o\left(\frac{1}{(T-1)^{1+\eta}}\right)+O\left(\frac{\log T}{(T-1)^{1+\min(\delta,1)}}\right)+O\left(\frac{1}{(T-1)^{\frac{3}{2}}}\right). \displaystyle=o\left(\frac{1}{(T-1)^{1+\eta}}\right) $$

All together, we have shown,

$$ \displaystyle(T-1)\sum_{j=2}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\{\frac{1}{T-j+1}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{k-1}\right]\right)\right\}^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{2}} \displaystyle\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[\left\{\frac{1}{T-j+1}\sum_{k=j}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)+\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{R_{k}\mathbb{I}(A_{k}=a)}{\hat{\pi}_{k-1}(\bm{X}_{k},a)}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{k},a)\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{k-1}\right]\right)\right\}^{2}\right]^{\frac{1}{2}}\rightarrow 0. $$

As $L_{1}$ convergence implies convergence in probability, Equation (S13) converges to zero in probability.

∎

## Appendix S4 Proof of Corollary 1

#### Proof.

Given Theorem 2, it suffices to show:

$$ \left|\frac{v_{T}}{\hat{v}_{T}}-1\right|\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p}}{{\longrightarrow}}0. $$

We begin by noting that $\forall\epsilon>0$ ,

$$ \mathbb{P}\left(\left|\frac{v_{T}}{\hat{v}_{T}}-1\right|>\epsilon\right)\ =\ \mathbb{P}\left(\left|{v_{T}}-{\hat{v}_{T}}\right|>\epsilon\hat{v}_{T}\right). $$

Condition (C1) in the proof of Theorem 2 implies that there exists a constant $c_{1}>0$ such that $\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\mathbb{P}\left(v_{T}<c_{1}/2\right)=0$ . Theorem 3, together with the Continuous Mapping Theorem, yields $\left|\hat{v}_{T}-v_{T}\right|\stackrel{{\scriptstyle p}}{{\longrightarrow}}0$ . Therefore,

$$ \lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\mathbb{P}\left(|\hat{v}_{T}|<\frac{c_{1}}{4}\right)\leq\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\mathbb{P}\left(|\hat{v}_{T}-v_{T}|>\frac{c_{1}}{4}\right)+\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\mathbb{P}\left(|v_{T}|<{\frac{c_{1}}{2}}\right)=0. $$

Finally, for all $\epsilon>0$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|{v_{T}}-{\hat{v}_{T}}\Bigr|>\epsilon\hat{v}_{T}\right) \displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\left(|\hat{v}_{T}|\geq\frac{c_{1}}{4},\Bigr|{v_{T}}-{\hat{v}_{T}}\Bigr|>\frac{c_{1}\epsilon}{4}\right)+\mathbb{P}\left(|v_{T}|<\frac{c_{1}}{4}\right) \displaystyle\leq\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|{v_{T}}-{\hat{v}_{T}}\Bigr|>\frac{c_{1}\epsilon}{4}\right)+\mathbb{P}\left(|v_{T}|<\frac{c_{1}}{4}\right), $$

and the right-hand-side goes to 0 as $T\rightarrow\infty$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\Bigr|\frac{v_{T}}{\hat{v}_{T}}-1\Bigr|\xrightarrow{p}0. $$

∎

## Appendix S5 Proof of Corollary 2

#### Proof.

By the definition of the value function,

$$ \displaystyle(T-1)\mathbb{E}\left[|\Delta(\hat{\pi}_{T},\hat{\pi}_{T-1})|\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle(T-1)\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\left(\hat{\pi}_{T}(\bm{X})-\hat{\pi}_{T-1}(\bm{X})\right)\right|\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle(T-1)K\mu_{U}\cdot\sup_{a}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{T}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{T-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle(T-1)K\mu_{U}\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[Q_{T}\right]\leq K\mu_{U}T^{-\delta}\rightarrow 0. $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[|\Delta(\hat{\pi}_{T},\hat{\pi}_{T-1})|\right]=o\left(\frac{1}{T}\right) $$

and $\Delta(\hat{\pi}_{T},\hat{\pi}_{T-1})\xrightarrow{P}0.$ Since $\bigr|\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})\bigr|\leq\bigr|\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})\bigr|+\bigr|V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})\bigr|$ , Theorem 1 implies $\bigr|\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})\bigr|=o_{p}(1)$ , and as $T\rightarrow\infty$ , we have $\bigr|\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})\bigr|\xrightarrow{P}0.$ Since

$$ \sqrt{T-1}\cdot\frac{\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})}{\hat{v}_{T}}=\sqrt{T-1}\cdot\frac{\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})}{\hat{v}_{T}}+\sqrt{T-1}\cdot\frac{V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})}{\hat{v}_{T}}, $$

and by Corollary 1,

$$ \sqrt{T-1}\cdot\frac{\widehat{V}(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})}{\hat{v}_{T}}\xrightarrow{d}\mathcal{N}(0,1), $$

it suffices to show that

$$ \displaystyle\sqrt{T-1}\cdot\frac{V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T})}{\hat{v}_{T}}\xrightarrow{P}0. $$

In the proof of corollary 1, we have shown that

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(|\hat{v}_{T}|<\frac{c_{1}}{4}\right)\rightarrow 0. $$

Equation (S32) implies $\sqrt{T-1}(V(\hat{\pi}_{T-1})-V(\hat{\pi}_{T}))\xrightarrow{P}0$ . Therefore, Equation (S33) holds. ∎

## Appendix S6 Lemmas and their proofs

### S6.1 Lemma 1

Recall the following definitions,

$$ \displaystyle\Lambda_{T,j} \displaystyle:=\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle\sigma_{T,j}^{2} \displaystyle:=\mathbb{E}\left[\Lambda_{T,j}^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle S_{T}^{2} \displaystyle:=\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\sigma_{T,j}^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]. $$

#### Proof.

Using the Theorem of Heyde and Brown, (2010), there exists a constant $K_{1}$ such that

$$ \displaystyle\sup_{w}\biggr|\mathbb{P}\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\Lambda_{T,j}\leq S_{T}w\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{f(T)}\right)-\Phi(w)\biggr| \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle K_{1}\left\{S_{T}^{-4}\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}[\Lambda_{T,j}^{4}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}]+\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sigma_{T,j}^{2}-S_{T}^{2}\right)^{2}\ \Biggr|\ \bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]\right)\right\}^{\frac{1}{5}}. $$

Therefore, it suffices to show

- 1. There exists a constant $c_{2}$ such that

$$ \mathbb{P}\left(\sqrt{T-f(T)}S_{T}\geq c_{2}\right)\rightarrow 1. $$

- 2.

$$ (T-f(T))^{2}\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}[\Lambda_{T,j}^{4}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}]\xrightarrow{P}0. $$

- 3.

$$ (T-f(T))^{2}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sigma_{T,j}^{2}-S_{T}^{2}\right)^{2}\ \Biggr|\ \bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]\xrightarrow{P}0 $$

#### The term $\sqrt{T-f(T)}S_{T}$ is lower bounded by a constant in probability.

Using the definition of $\sigma_{T,j}$ , we can write,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sigma^{2}_{T,j} \displaystyle= \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\Lambda_{T,j}^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right]\right)^{2}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}-\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}_{j}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X}_{j})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}. $$

By Jensen’s inequality and Cauchy-Schwartz inequality, for all $j$ and $\bm{X}\in\mathcal{X}$ , we have,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\right]^{2} \displaystyle\leq\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\left(\sum_{a=1}^{K}\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\right)^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\left(\sum_{a=1}^{K}\sqrt{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\cdot\sqrt{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}\right)^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}\cdot\sum_{a=1}^{K}{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}\right] \displaystyle=\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}\right] $$

Therefore, using Assumption 4, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sigma^{2}_{T,j} \displaystyle\geq\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle\geq\frac{T-f(T)}{(T-1)^{2}}\sigma_{L}^{2}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right] \displaystyle=\frac{T-f(T)}{(T-1)^{2}}\sigma_{L}^{2}. $$

This implies,

$$ \displaystyle\sqrt{T-f(T)}S_{T} \displaystyle=\sqrt{T-f(T)}\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\sigma_{T,j}^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \displaystyle\geq\sqrt{T-f(T)}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{T-f(T)}}{T-1}\sigma_{L} \displaystyle=\frac{T-f(T)}{T-1}\sigma_{L}. $$

When T is sufficiently large, $\frac{T-f(T)}{T-1}$ will be greater than $\frac{1}{2}$ , yielding,

$$ \sqrt{T-f(T)}S_{T}\geq\frac{\sigma_{L}}{2}. $$

#### The term $\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}(T-f(T))^{2}\mathbb{E}[\Lambda_{T,j}^{4}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}]$ converges to zero in probability.

We can write,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}(T-f(T))^{2}\mathbb{E}[\Lambda_{T,j}^{4}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}] \displaystyle= \displaystyle(T-f(T))^{2}\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right]\right)^{4}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 16(T-f(T))^{2}\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{I}(A_{j}=a)R_{j}}{T-1}\right)^{4}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{j-1}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{16KK_{4}(T-f(T))^{3}}{(T-1)^{4}}=o(1), $$

where the last inequality is due to Assumption 5. Therefore, we have the desired result,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}(T-f(T))^{2}\mathbb{E}[\Lambda_{T,j}^{4}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}]\xrightarrow{P}0. $$

#### The term $(T-f(T))^{2}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\sum_{j=f(T)+1}^{T}\sigma_{T,j}^{2}-S_{T}^{2}\right)^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]$ converges to zero in probability.

Using the expression of $\sigma_{T,j}^{2}$ derived above, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\sigma_{T,j}^{2}= \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}-\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}. $$

Since

$$ \displaystyle~\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))(\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a))\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}} $$

and

$$ \displaystyle~\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle= \displaystyle~\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}-\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle~+\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}, $$

we can write $\sigma_{T,j}^{2}$ as follows,

$$ \displaystyle\sigma_{T,j}^{2}= \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\left(\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}-\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle-\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}-\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}. $$

Since $\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}\in\sigma(\bm{H}_{f(T)})$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\sigma_{T,j}^{2}\mid\bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]= \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\left(\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{f(T)}\right] \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[(\mu_{a}(\bm{X})^{2}+\sigma_{a}^{2}(\bm{X}))\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]}{(T-1)^{2}}-\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}} \displaystyle-\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}-\mathbb{E}_{\bm{X}}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mu_{a}(\bm{X})\hat{\pi}_{f(T)}(\bm{X},a)\right]^{2}}{(T-1)^{2}}\ \Bigr|\ \bm{H}_{f(T)}\right]. $$

Therefore,

### S6.3 Lemma 3

#### Lemma 3

Suppose $\alpha$ is a positive constant, then

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=\begin{cases}\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}t^{-\alpha},&\alpha>1\\
\infty,&0<\alpha\leq 1.\end{cases} $$

Furthermore,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=O\left(\frac{\log T}{T^{\alpha}}\right),\ \ \forall\ 0<\alpha<1 $$

#### Proof.

We consider three different scenarios separately: $0<\alpha<1$ , $\alpha=1$ , and $1<\alpha$ .

#### Case 1: $\alpha=1$ .

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t(T-t)}=\frac{1}{T}\left(\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}+\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{T-t}\right)=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{2}{t}. $$

Therefore,

$$ \lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}2\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}=\infty, $$

and

$$ \lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sqrt{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{2}{\sqrt{T}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}=0. $$

#### Case 2: $0<\alpha<1$ .

Since

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}\geq\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t(T-t)}, $$

we have

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}\geq\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t(T-t)}=\infty. $$

On the other side, by Holder’s inequality,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)} \displaystyle=\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)^{\alpha}}\cdot\frac{1}{(T-t)^{1-\alpha}} \displaystyle\leq\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\left(t^{-\alpha}(T-t)^{-\alpha}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}\right]^{\alpha}\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\left((T-t)^{-1+\alpha}\right)^{\frac{1}{1-\alpha}}\right]^{1-\alpha} \displaystyle\leq\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t(T-t)}\right]^{\alpha}\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{T-t}\right]^{1-\alpha} \displaystyle\leq\left[\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{2}{t}\right]^{\alpha}\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}\right]^{1-\alpha} \displaystyle\leq\frac{2^{\alpha}}{T^{\alpha}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}. $$

Therefore,

$$ \sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t^{\alpha}(T-t)}=O\left(\frac{\log T}{T^{\alpha}}\right). $$

#### Case 3: $\alpha>1$ .

For any $\alpha>1$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha}}=\frac{1}{Tt^{\alpha}}+\frac{1}{T^{2}t^{\alpha-1}}+\cdots+\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]}t^{1+\alpha-[\alpha]}}+\frac{1}{(T-t)T^{[\alpha]}t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}, $$

where $[x]$ denotes the largest integer that is no larger than $x$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha}} \displaystyle=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}t^{-\alpha}+\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k+1}}+\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}, $$

which implies

$$ \displaystyle T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha}} \displaystyle=\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}t^{-\alpha}+\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}}+\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]-1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}. $$

We consider each term in turn. For the first term, since $\alpha>0$ , we have,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}t^{-\alpha}=\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}t^{-\alpha}. $$

For the second term, since $1\leq k\leq[\alpha]-1$ and $0\leq t^{-\alpha+k}\leq\ t^{-\alpha+[\alpha]-1}\leq t^{-1}$ , we have,

$$ \displaystyle 0\leq\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}}\leq\frac{1}{tT}. $$

Therefore, we have

$$ \displaystyle 0\leq\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}} \displaystyle\leq([\alpha]-1)\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{tT}, $$

which implies,

$$ \displaystyle 0\leq\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}} \displaystyle\leq([\alpha]-1)\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{tT}=0, $$

yielding the desired result,

$$ \lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}}=0. $$

Lastly, for the third term, if $\alpha$ is an integer, we must have $\alpha\geq 2$ because $\alpha>1$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]-1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}=\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{T^{\alpha-1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{T-t}=0. $$

If $\alpha$ is not an integer, then $0<\alpha-[\alpha]<1$ . Applying the result of Case 2, we have

$$ 0\leq\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]-1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}\leq\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}=0. $$

Therefore, when $\alpha>1$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}T\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha}} \displaystyle=\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}\left(\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}t^{-\alpha}+\sum_{k=1}^{[\alpha]-1}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{t^{-\alpha+k}}{T^{k}}+\frac{1}{T^{[\alpha]-1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T-1}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\alpha-[\alpha]}}\right) \displaystyle=\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}t^{-\alpha}+0+0 \displaystyle=\sum_{t=1}^{\infty}t^{-\alpha}<\infty. $$

for any $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X},1\leq a\leq K$ , $2\leq j\leq T$ , we have

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a) \displaystyle=\frac{1}{T-1} \displaystyle\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1} \displaystyle=-\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{(T-t)(T-t-1)} \displaystyle\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2} \displaystyle\leq\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\frac{2|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)} $$

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a) \displaystyle=\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\frac{\hat{\pi}_{1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1}+\sum_{t=2}^{j-1}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-t}\right)=\frac{1}{T-1} $$

$$ \displaystyle\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1} \displaystyle= \displaystyle\frac{\hat{\pi}_{1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1}+\sum_{t=2}^{j-1}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-t}-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1} \displaystyle= \displaystyle\frac{\hat{\pi}_{1}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1}+\sum_{t=2}^{j-1}\frac{(\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a))-(\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a))}{T-t} \displaystyle= \displaystyle-\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\frac{\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{(T-t)(T-t-1)}. $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2} \displaystyle=\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\sum_{t_{2}=1}^{j-2}\frac{(\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a))\cdot(\hat{\pi}_{t_{2}}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a))}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-t_{2})(T-t_{2}-1)} \displaystyle\leq\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\frac{2|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)}\cdot\sum_{t_{2}=1}^{j-2}\frac{1}{(T-t_{2})(T-t_{2}-1)} \displaystyle\leq\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\frac{2|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)} $$

Finally, since $|\pi_{t}(\bm{x},a)|<1$ for all $t,x,a$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\left|\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{x},a)\right| \displaystyle\leq\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{j-1}|}{T-1}+\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{x},a)|}{(T-t)(T-t-1)} \displaystyle\leq\frac{1}{T-1}+2\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\frac{1}{(T-t)(T-t-1)} \displaystyle\leq\frac{1}{T-1}+2\left(\frac{1}{T-j+1}-\frac{1}{T-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq\frac{2}{T-j+1} $$

∎

### S6.5 Lemma 5

#### Lemma 5

Under Assumptions 1–5, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T^{\prime}\rightarrow\infty}\sup_{T\geq T^{\prime}}\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right|\right]<\infty, $$

where $\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}$ is defined in Equation (S1).

#### Proof.

Applying Lemma 4, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t)(T-t-1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\sum_{i=t+1}^{j-1}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{i}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{i-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t)(T-t-1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\sum_{i=t+1}^{j-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{Q_{i}}{(T-t)(T-t-1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}\left[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}\right]\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t=1}^{j-2}\sum_{i=t+1}^{j-1}\frac{i^{-1-\delta}}{(T-t)(T-t-1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}\left[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}\right]\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\sum_{i=t+1}^{T-1}\sum_{j=i+1}^{T}\frac{i^{-1-\delta}}{(T-t)(T-t-1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}\left[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}\right]\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\sum_{i=t+1}^{T-1}\frac{i^{-1-\delta}}{T-t} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}\left[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}\right]\cdot\frac{1}{\delta}\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\delta}}. $$

Lemma 3 shows $\sum_{t=1}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t)t^{\delta}}=O\left(\frac{\log T}{T^{\min(\delta,1)}}\right)$ , and therefore we have the desired result,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T^{\prime}\rightarrow\infty}\sup_{T\geq T^{\prime}}\frac{(T-1)^{\min(\delta,1)}}{\log T}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left|\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right|\right]<\infty. $$

∎

### S6.6 Lemma 6

#### Lemma 6

Under Assumptions 1–5, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}(T-1)^{1+\eta}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2}\right]=0, $$

where $\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}$ is defined in Equation (S1).

#### Proof.

By Lemma 4, we have,

$$ \displaystyle(T-1)^{1+\eta}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{a=1}^{K}\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle(T-1)^{1+\eta}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\frac{2|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right]. $$

Under Assumption 3, we have $0\leq\eta<\frac{\delta}{\delta+1}$ . Therefore, there exists $\zeta$ such that

$$ \displaystyle\frac{\eta}{\delta}<\zeta<1-\eta. $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{j-2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] \displaystyle= \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=T^{\zeta}+2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{j-2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] \displaystyle+2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{\min(j-2,T^{\zeta}-1)}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] $$

We will bound each of these two terms in turn. The first term in Equation (S49) can be bounded with the following expression

$$ \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=T^{\zeta}+2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{j-2}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=T^{\zeta}+2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{j-2}\sum_{i=t_{1}+1}^{j-1}\frac{\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}]}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\sum_{i=t_{1}+1}^{T-1}\sum_{j=i+1}^{T}\frac{\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}]}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}\cdot\log T\cdot K\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\sum_{i=t_{1}+1}^{T-1}\frac{\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}]}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}\cdot\log T\cdot K\cdot\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}]\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\sum_{i=t_{1}+1}^{T-1}\frac{i^{-1-\delta}}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}\cdot\log T\cdot K\cdot\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}]\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{t_{1}^{-1-\delta}(T-1-t_{1})}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}\cdot\log T\cdot K\cdot\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}]\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t_{1})t_{1}^{1+\delta}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{\eta}\cdot\log T\cdot K\cdot\sup_{i\geq 1}\mathbb{E}[Q_{i}i^{1+\delta}]\left(\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t_{1})t_{1}^{\delta}}+\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{t_{1}^{1+\delta}}\right). $$

By Lemma 3, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t_{1})t_{1}^{\delta}}=O\left(\frac{\log T}{T^{\min\{\delta,1\}}}\right),\ \ \sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{t_{1}^{1+\delta}}=O\left(\frac{1}{T^{\zeta\delta}}\right) $$

and $\zeta>\frac{\eta}{\delta}$ , $\delta>\eta,\eta<1$ . Therefore, we have the desired result,

$$ \displaystyle(T-1)^{\eta}\log T\left(\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{(T-t_{1})t_{1}^{\delta}}+\sum_{t_{1}=T^{\zeta}}^{T-2}\frac{1}{t_{1}^{1+\delta}}\right)=o(1), $$

implying that the term in Equation (S49) is $o(1)$ .

Next, the term in Equation (S50) can be bounded as,

$$ \displaystyle 2(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{\min(j-2,T^{\zeta}-1)}\sup_{1\leq a\leq K}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{|\hat{\pi}_{t_{1}}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)|}{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 4(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{t_{1}=1}^{\min(j-2,T^{\zeta}-1)}\frac{1}{{(T-t_{1})(T-t_{1}-1)(T-j+1)}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 4(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\sum_{j=2}^{T}\frac{T^{\zeta}}{{(T-T^{\zeta})(T-T^{\zeta}-1)(T-j+1)}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle 4(T-1)^{1+\eta}K\log T\cdot\frac{T^{\zeta}}{(T-T^{\zeta}-1)^{2}} $$

Since $\zeta<1-\eta$ ,

$$ (T-1)^{1+\eta}\log T\frac{T^{\zeta}}{(T-T^{\zeta}-1)^{2}}=o(1). $$

Therefore, we have the desired result,

$$ \displaystyle\lim_{T\rightarrow\infty}(T-1)^{1+\eta}\sum_{j=2}^{T}\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\tilde{\pi}_{T,j}(\bm{X}_{j},a)-\frac{\hat{\pi}_{j-1}(\bm{X}_{j},a)}{T-1}\right)^{2}\right]\stackrel{{\scriptstyle P}}{{\rightarrow}}0. $$

∎

## Appendix S8 Proof of Theorem 4

Define the following linear contextual bandit updates after the $t$ th iteration,

$$ \displaystyle\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}=\left(\lambda I+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})^{\top}\right)^{-1}\left(\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})R_{s}\right), $$

where $\lambda$ is the ridge penalization parameter. In the later part, we will denote

$$ \displaystyle\bar{V}_{t}=\left(\lambda I+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})\Phi(\bm{X}_{t},A_{t})^{\top}\right). $$

Under Assumptions 6–9,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\lambda_{\min}\left(\bar{V}_{t}\right)\leq\lambda+\frac{1}{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle d\cdot\exp\left(-\frac{\left(\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}\right)^{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)^{2}}{256L^{4}t}\right)+d\cdot\exp\left(-\frac{\left(\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}\right)^{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)^{2}}{512L^{4}\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}^{2}}\right) \displaystyle= \displaystyle O\left(\exp\left(-t^{1-2\zeta}\right)\right) $$

Proof is in Appendix S8.4.

#### Corollary 3

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\lambda_{\max}(\bar{V}_{t}^{-1})\geq\frac{1}{\lambda+\frac{1}{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle d\cdot\exp\left(-\frac{\left(\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}\right)^{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)^{2}}{256L^{4}t}\right)+d\cdot\exp\left(-\frac{\left(\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}\right)^{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)^{2}}{512L^{4}\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}^{2}}\right) \displaystyle= \displaystyle O\left(\exp\left(-t^{1-2\zeta}\right)\right) $$

We will now prove that the stability condition holds for each of the three bandit algorithms above. In all of our proofs, we will use $\pi^{*}(\bm{x},a)$ to denote the optimal policy under the context $\bm{x}$ and action $a$ .

### S8.1 $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm

#### Proof.

Notice for the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm,

$$ \displaystyle\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)=\begin{cases}\frac{c_{t}}{K-1},&\text{if }a\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\\
1-c_{t},&\text{if }a=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\end{cases}. $$

For any $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ , if

$$ \operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}, $$

then, we have $\sup_{a=1,2,\ldots,K}|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{x},a)|\leq|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\right)\times|c_{t}-c_{t-1}| \displaystyle+\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|+\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\right). $$

In addition, for any given $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ and $a\in\{1,2,\ldots,K\}$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\left|\Phi(\bm{x},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\right|\leq\frac{\Delta(\bm{x})}{3}\quad\text{and}\ \  \displaystyle\left|\Phi(\bm{x},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\right|\leq\frac{\Delta(\bm{x})}{3} $$

implies $\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}$ . Recall that $\Delta(\bm{x})$ is defined in Assumption 8 and represents the gap of expected rewards between best arm and second-best arm under context $\bm{x}$ . Intuitively, if both the estimated expected reward under $\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}$ and $\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}$ are within $\frac{\Delta(\bm{x})}{3}$ difference of the actual expected reward, then the estimated best arm under $\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}$ and $\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}$ should be the same. Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\exists a\in\{1,2,\ldots,K\},\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|>\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\ \ \text{or}\ \ \Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|>\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right)+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right)+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\cdot\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})^{2}}{9}\right) \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\cdot\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})^{2}}{9}\right). $$

Notice for any $a$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\cdot\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})^{2}}{9}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3\sqrt{t}}\right)+\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\sqrt{t}\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) $$

We bound each of these two terms in turn. For the first term,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3\sqrt{t}}\right)\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\lVert\Phi(\bm{X},a)\rVert^{2}\lambda_{\max}\left(\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\right)\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3\sqrt{t}}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\lambda_{\max}(\bar{V}_{t}^{-1})\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3L^{2}\sqrt{t}}\right) \displaystyle= \displaystyle O\left(\exp\left(-t^{1-2\zeta}\right)\right), $$

which follow from Corollary 3 and Assumption 9. For the second term, according to Abbasi-Yadkori et al., (2011), for any $\delta>0$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq U\sqrt{dK\log\left(\frac{t^{2}L/\lambda+1}{\delta}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}S}\right)\leq\delta, $$

where $U$ is the parameter for the sub-Gaussian distribution of rewards and $S$ is the bound for norm of the true parameter, i.e., $||\bm{\Theta}||\leq S$ . Therefore, let $\delta=\exp(-t^{\frac{1}{2}})$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq U\sqrt{dt^{\frac{1}{2}}\log\left({t^{2}L/\lambda+1}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}}\right)\leq\exp(-t^{\frac{1}{2}}). $$

When $t$ is sufficiently large, $\frac{1}{2}\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})\sqrt{t}\geq U\sqrt{dt^{\frac{1}{2}}\log\left({t^{2}L/\lambda+1}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}}$ and for any $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\sqrt{t}\Delta(\bm{X})}{2}\right)\leq\exp(-t^{\frac{1}{2}})=O\left(\exp\left(-\sqrt{t}\right)\right). $$

Plugging Equations (S53) and (S54) into Equation (S52), we have

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\cdot\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})^{2}}{4}\right)=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,\ 0.5\}}\right)\right). $$

Therefore,

$$ \sup_{a=1,2,..,K}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right]=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,0.5\}}\right)\right)+|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|. $$

Under Assumption 9, $|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|=|t^{-\zeta}-(t-1)^{-\zeta}|$ . When $\zeta=0$ , this term is 0 and when $0<\zeta<\frac{1}{2}$ , $|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|=O\left(\frac{1}{t^{1+\zeta}}\right)$ . Therefore, the stability condition is satisfied.

∎

### S8.2 Upper Confidence Bound

For UCB algorithms, we denote the $(1-\delta)$ confidence set of $\hat{\Theta}_{t}$ as $C_{t}$ :

$$ \displaystyle C_{t}:=\left\{\tilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in\mathbb{R}^{dK}:\|\hat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\tilde{\bm{\Theta}}\|_{\bar{V}_{t}}\leq R\sqrt{dK\log\left(\frac{1+tL^{2}/\lambda}{\delta}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}S}\right\}, $$

and

$$ \displaystyle\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)=\begin{cases}\frac{c_{t}}{K-1},&\text{if }a\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\\
1-c_{t},&\text{if }a=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\end{cases}. $$

For any $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ , if

$$ \operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{x},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}, $$

then $\sup_{a=1,2,\ldots,K}|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{x},a)|\leq|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\right)\times|c_{t}-c_{t-1}| \displaystyle+\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|+\mathbb{P}\left(\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\right). $$

For any given $\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}$ , $a\in\{1,2,\ldots,K\}$ , $\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}$ , $\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\in C_{t-1}$ , we have,

$$ \Bigr|\Phi(\bm{x},a)^{\top}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\leq\frac{\Delta(\bm{x})}{3},\quad\text{and}\ \ \Bigr|\Phi(\bm{x},a)^{\top}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\leq\frac{\Delta(\bm{x})}{3}, $$

which implies $\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}$ . Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\arg\max_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\not=\operatornamewithlimits{argmax}_{\tilde{a}=1,2,\ldots,K,\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\in C_{t-1}}\Phi(\bm{X},\tilde{a})^{\top}\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{3}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}+\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\in C_{t-1}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}+\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{3}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right)+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\in C_{t-1}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) \displaystyle+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right). $$

The previous results for the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm have shown,

$$ \displaystyle\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\tilde{\Theta}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right)+\sum_{a=1}^{K}\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) \displaystyle= \displaystyle O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,\ 0.5\}}\right)\right). $$

We can bound the first term by as follows,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\cdot\Bigr|(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\tilde{\Theta}_{t}-\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})^{2}}{36}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6\sqrt{t}}\right)+\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|(\hat{\Theta}_{t}-\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\sqrt{t}\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) $$

Since by the definition of $\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}$ ,

$$ \displaystyle\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\|\hat{\bm{\Theta}}-\tilde{\bm{\Theta}}\|_{\bar{V}_{t}}\leq U\sqrt{dK\log\left(\frac{1+tL^{2}/\lambda}{\delta}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}S}, $$

we can use the exact same proof as for the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm to show that

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}\Phi(\bm{X},a)\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6\sqrt{t}}\right)+\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\sqrt{t}\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right) \displaystyle= \displaystyle O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,\ 0.5\}}\right)\right) $$

and

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}\in C_{t}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\hat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right)=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,\ 0.5\}}\right)\right). $$

Similarly,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\sup_{\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}\in C_{t-1}}\Bigr|\Phi(\bm{X},a)^{\top}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{\frac{1}{2}}\bar{V}_{t-1}^{-\frac{1}{2}}(\widetilde{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1}-\hat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t-1})\Bigr|\geq\frac{\Delta(\bm{X})}{6}\right)=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,\ 0.5\}}\right)\right). $$

Thus, we have

$$ \sup_{a=1,2,..,K}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right]=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{\min\{1-2\zeta,0.5\}}\right)\right)+|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|, $$

implying that the stability condition is satisfied.

### S8.3 Thompson Sampling

Suppose the prior distribution of $\bm{\bm{\Theta}}$ is a Gaussian distribution with mean $\bm{\mu}_{0}$ and covariance matrix $\bm{\Sigma}_{0}$ . For Thompson Sampling, after the $t$ -th iteration, the posterior distribution of $\bm{\Theta}$ is a Gaussian distribution with mean $\bm{\mu}_{t}$ and covariance matrix $\bm{\Sigma}_{t}$ , where

$$ \displaystyle\bm{\mu}_{t} \displaystyle=\bm{\Sigma}_{t}\left(\bm{\Sigma}_{0}^{-1}\bm{\mu}_{0}+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})R_{s}\right), \displaystyle\bm{\Sigma}_{t} \displaystyle=\left(\bm{\Sigma}_{0}^{-1}+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})^{\top}\right)^{-1}. $$

For simplicity, assume the prior $\bm{\mu}_{0}=0$ and $\bm{\Sigma}_{0}^{-1}=\bm{V}_{0}=\lambda I$ . Then,

$$ \displaystyle\bm{\mu}_{t} \displaystyle=\widehat{\Theta}_{t}=\left(\lambda I+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})^{\top}\right)^{-1}\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})R_{s}, \displaystyle\bm{\Sigma}_{t} \displaystyle=\left(\lambda I+\sum_{s=1}^{t}\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})\Phi(\bm{X}_{s},A_{s})^{\top}\right)^{-1}. $$

Therefore,

$$ \displaystyle\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)=\begin{cases}\frac{c_{t}}{K-1},&\text{if }\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)=\max_{1\leq a\leq K}\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)\right)<\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\\
\alpha_{t}\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)=\max_{1\leq a\leq K}\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)\right)&\text{if }\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\leq\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)=\max_{1\leq a\leq K}\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)\right)\leq 1-c_{t}\\
1-c_{t},&\text{if }\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)=\max_{1\leq a\leq K}\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)\right)>1-c_{t}\end{cases} $$

where $\bm{\gamma}_{t}\sim N(\bm{\mu}_{t},\Sigma_{t})$ . Thus, for any $a\not=a^{*}(\bm{x})$ where $a^{*}(\bm{x})$ is defined in Assumption 8 and is the optimal arm under context $\bm{x}$ , we have,

$$ \displaystyle\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1} \displaystyle\Longleftrightarrow\  \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)=\max_{1\leq a\leq K}\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)\right)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1} \displaystyle\Longleftrightarrow\  \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a)>\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x}))\right)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1} \displaystyle\Longleftrightarrow\  \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left((\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})\Phi(\bm{x},a)>(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x}))+\bm{\Theta}^{\top}(\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x}))-\Phi(\bm{x},a))\right)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1} \displaystyle\Longleftrightarrow\  \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left((\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})\Phi(\bm{x},a)>(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x}))+\Delta(\bm{x})\right)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1} \displaystyle\Longleftrightarrow\  \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left((\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))>\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})\right)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}. $$

On the other hand, by Markov inequality, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left((\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))>\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{\mathbb{E}_{\bm{\gamma}_{t}}\left[\left\{(\bm{\gamma}_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))\right\}^{2}\right]}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{\left\{(\mu_{t}^{\top}-\bm{\Theta}^{\top})(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))\right\}^{2}+(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))^{\top}\bm{\Sigma}_{t}(\Phi(\bm{x},a)-\Phi(\bm{x},a^{*}(\bm{x})))}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}} \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\frac{L^{2}||\mu_{t}-\bm{\Theta}||^{2}+L^{2}\lambda_{\max}(\bm{\Sigma}_{t})}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}} $$

Therefore, we have,

$$ \displaystyle\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{x},a)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\Rightarrow\frac{L^{2}||\mu_{t}-\bm{\Theta}||^{2}+L^{2}\lambda_{\max}(\Sigma_{t})}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}} \displaystyle>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}. $$

Utilizing this result, we obtain,

$$ \displaystyle\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}\mathbb{E}\left[|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\sup_{a=1,2,..,K}|\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)-\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)|\right] \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|\mathbb{P}\left(\forall a\not=a^{*}(\bm{X}),\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)=\frac{c_{t}}{K-1},\hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)=\frac{c_{t-1}}{K-1}\right) \displaystyle+\mathbb{P}\left(\exists a\not=a^{*}(\bm{X}),\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\ \ \text{or}\ \ \hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)>\frac{c_{t-1}}{K-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|+\mathbb{P}\left(\exists a\not=a^{*}(\bm{X}),\hat{\pi}_{t}(\bm{X},a)>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\ \ \text{or}\ \ \hat{\pi}_{t-1}(\bm{X},a)>\frac{c_{t-1}}{K-1}\right) \displaystyle\leq \displaystyle|c_{t}-c_{t-1}|+K\mathbb{P}\left(\frac{L^{2}||\mu_{t}-\bm{\Theta}||^{2}+L^{2}\lambda_{\max}(\bm{\Sigma}_{t})}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}}>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\right)+K\mathbb{P}\left(\frac{L^{2}||\mu_{t-1}-\bm{\Theta}||^{2}+L^{2}\lambda_{\max}(\bm{\Sigma}_{t-1})}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}}>\frac{c_{t-1}}{K-1}\right) $$

Notice the definition of $\bm{\mu}_{t}$ is the same as that of $\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}$ in the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm. Similarly, the definition of $\bm{\Sigma}_{t}$ is the same as $\bar{V}_{t}^{-1}$ in the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm. Therefore, using the results in the $\epsilon$ -greedy algorithm:

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}\bar{V}_{t}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\geq U\sqrt{dK\log\left(\frac{t^{2}L/\lambda+1}{\delta}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}S}\right) \displaystyle\leq\delta \displaystyle\Longrightarrow\ \mathbb{P}\left(\Bigr|(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})^{\top}(\widehat{\bm{\Theta}}_{t}-\bm{\Theta})\Bigr|\cdot\lambda_{\min}(\bar{V}_{t})\geq U\sqrt{dK\log\left(\frac{t^{2}L/\lambda+1}{\delta}\right)+\lambda^{1/2}S}\right) \displaystyle\leq\delta $$

and

$$ \displaystyle\mathbb{P}\left(\lambda_{\max}(\bar{V}_{t}^{-1})\geq\frac{1}{\lambda+\frac{1}{2}\lambda_{\min}\left(\mathbb{E}\left[\bm{X}\bm{X}^{\top}\right]\right)\sum_{s=1}^{t}c_{s-1}}\right)=O\left(\exp\left(-t^{1-2\zeta}\right)\right), $$

we can bound the probability $\mathbb{P}\left(\frac{L^{2}||\mu_{t}-\bm{\Theta}||^{2}+L^{2}\lambda_{\max}(\bm{\Sigma}_{t})}{|\inf_{\bm{x}\in\mathcal{X}}\Delta(\bm{x})|^{2}}>\frac{c_{t}}{K-1}\right)$ as below:
